titel: Model too big for your printer? Split it to fit 🔥 | Blender
printzin: Measured in Blender, not print tested by us yet.

scenes.tekst: Model too big for your print bed?
scenes.label: QUICK QUESTION

scenes.tekst: Pick your printer from the list, or type in your own bed size.
scenes.label: STEP 1

scenes.tekst: Then press Split to fit, the one big button in the panel.
scenes.label: STEP 2

scenes.tekst: Open model? It makes a watertight copy first, in the same click.
scenes.label: NO PREP

scenes.tekst: It cuts the model into the fewest parts that each fit your bed.
scenes.label: THE CUT

scenes.tekst: Parts that touch never share a color, so you see every cut.
scenes.label: COLORS

scenes.tekst: Cuts get pins and pin holes, with a clearance you can tune to your printer.
scenes.label: PINS
scenes.uitspraak: Cuts get pins and pin holes, with a clearance you can tune to your printer.

scenes.tekst: The panel tells you in one line: all parts fit the bed.
scenes.label: RESULT

scenes.tekst: Face too small for a pin? The panel tells you to glue that joint.
scenes.label: GLUE NOTE

scenes.tekst: Then export every part and the pins as STL or 3MF, in millimeters.
scenes.label: EXPORT
scenes.uitspraak: Then export every part and the pins as S T L or three M F, in millimeters.

scenes.tekst: Measured in Blender, not print tested by us yet. Print the fit test first.
scenes.label: HONEST

scenes.tekst: Click Cuts for Blender. Link in the description.
scenes.label: CLICK CUTS
